note: Rolling the 2D side view, a fin turning edge-on was drawn at its full outline - most of it lying across the airframe - right up to the moment its tip crossed the body wall, and then dropped in one step. On a four-fin set that is two fin-shaped patches blinking out together, which reads as the drawing snapping rather than turning. Fins are clipped to the outside of the airframe now, so a fin slides into the tube wall and leaves with nothing to see. Note that a set of N identical fins genuinely repeats every 360/N degrees of roll - desktop OpenRocket does the same - so the repeat itself is geometry, not a defect. No numbers change.
